verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for a speech API platform, but the evidence pack documents no account-wide data export or offboarding capability. The CLI output-format switch (-o) and self-hosting options are adjacent features: they shape per-request output or deployment, not exporting all of a user's data in open formats.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
